architectural_units.name: Client
architectural_units.description: The client is the user of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Server
architectural_units.description: The server is the software that is responsible for processing user requests.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for displaying information to the user.

architectural_units.name: Business Layer
architectural_units.description: This layer is the core of the application and is responsible for processing all the information.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for storing all the data.

architectural_units.name: API Gateway
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for the management, authentication and authorization of platform users.

architectural_units.name: Core
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for performing the business logic of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Analytical Module
architectural_units.description: This service has the main function of obtaining and processing playlog, connection, and platform action data.

architectural_units.name: API Player
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for communicating with the players, receiving all information corresponding to them.

architectural_units.name: Web Socket
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for the communication between the platform and the players.

architectural_units.name: NestJS
architectural_units.description: Framework used to develop the different services that interact with each other.

architectural_units.name: TypeScript
architectural_units.description: Programming language used for the development of the backend.

architectural_units.name: AWS
architectural_units.description: Cloud services infrastructure used for deployment and data storage.

architectural_units.name: MySQL
architectural_units.description: Relational database used to store all necessary data for the system operation.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: Object storage service used to store JSON documents containing playlogs, connections, and audit trails.

architectural_units.name: DynamoDB
architectural_units.description: NoSQL database service used to store playlogs in real time.

architectural_units.name: Amazon Athena
architectural_units.description: Service that allows performing SQL queries on data stored in Amazon S3.

architectural_units.name: AWS Glue
architectural_units.description: Serverless data integration service used for metadata storage and data cataloging.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Streams
architectural_units.description: Data processing and ingestion service used for streaming data.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
architectural_units.description: Service used for loading large amounts of data into data stores.

architectural_units.name: Player
architectural_units.description: A device that allows screens to play content, connecting the screen to the company platform.
The presentation layer communicates with the business layer, more specifically with the Api Gateway, using the HTTP protocol.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: The communication between the two components [presentation layer and business layer] is carried out through the internet using the HTTP protocol and the REST API model. [...] the presentation layer communicates with the business layer, more specifically with the Api Gateway, using the HTTP protocol.
The Api Gateway processes requests to be able to send them to the Core service and the analytical module.
The communication between the Api Gateway service is via the TCP communication protocol.

architectural_units.name: TCP
architectural_units.description: As can be seen in figure 9.1, the communication between the Api Gateway service is via the TCP communication protocol.
The Web Socket service is responsible for the communication between the platform and the players.
The Core service interacts with the database, although it also interacts to a lesser extent with cloud services.
The analytical module mainly interacts with cloud services, although it also interacts to a lesser extent with the database.
The Web Socket service processes data from players and stores it in the database and cloud services.
The analytical module uses Amazon Athena to perform SQL queries on data stored in Amazon S3.
Kinesis Data Streams reads data from different generators (Producers) and sends them to the consumers (Kinesis Data Firehose).
Kinesis Data Firehose is responsible for saving data in Amazon S3.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The platform is a web service that follows the client-server architecture.

patterns.name: Three Layers
patterns.description: The client-server model uses a 3-layer architecture, where the system is divided into 3 layers.

patterns.name: API Gateway
patterns.description: This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform.
